title: AI Content System Install — Intake
description: Required fields before fulfillment clock starts. Validate intake JSON against this schema before running generate_pack.py.

client_name.description: Business or personal brand name used in pack folder and docs.

niche.description: What space they operate in (e.g. B2B sales coaching for SaaS founders).

offer.description: Primary paid offer they want content to support.

icp.description: Ideal client profile — who buys, situation, pain.

primary_platform.description: Primary channel; copy length and format adapt to this.

sample_links.description: URLs or paste references of posts/pages they like (voice + style).

cta_preference.description: Preferred CTA style: book call, freebie, reply, buy, DM keyword, etc.

tier.description: Paid tier. starter skips brand voice + ops board.

handle.description: Optional social handle for attribution in posts.

client_slug.description: Optional folder slug; default derived from client_name.
